'''Suvar Detta''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] and [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] who served under [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]].

==Biography==
When the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Yuuzhan Vong War|invaded]] [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], Suvar and his brother [[Cham Detta|Cham]] were with the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] and [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|Mandalore]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] in [[24 ABY/Legends|24 ABY]] as part of a group known as the [[Mandalorian Protectors (Spar)|Mandalorian Protectors]]. Piloting [[Gladiator-class assault fighter|''Gladiator''-class assault fighters]] during the war, the Dettas joined Fett on a mission a week after the [[Battle of Helska IV|invasion]] of the planet [[Helska system's star|Helska]]. [[Battle of Birgis|Assaulting]] a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] in orbit over [[Birgis]], Detta and the other Mandalorians occupied the station while the Yuuzhan Vong invaded the planet.<ref name="APM" />

Despite appearing to work for the Yuuzhan Vong, the Mandalorians were supplying information to the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] through [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Kubariet]]. Upon first meeting the Jedi, Detta had tried holding him down only to be disabled by a knee to the groin. Kubariet later agreed to cooperate and the mission to gain the Jedi's trust was successful.<ref name="APM" />
